children.name: Global Integrated Education Volunteers Association (GIEVA) was registered in 2006 as a nonprofit organization to improve access to quality education and global learning opportunities among young Nigerians. Over the years, GIEVA has grown to serve over 1,000 young Nigerians annually, with a strong focus on inclusive education, digital empowerment, and youth development.
